purpose: Symbolize the historical Linux strace frames of run 39723814228 (bun 1.3.14) against the official oven-sh/bun-v1.3.14 linux-x64 release and profile binaries. Attribution only; no fix is made or implied.
method: Release assets fetched to scratch and checked against the GitHub release digests.
Standard and profile binaries inspected with llvm-readobj/llvm-readelf (Homebrew LLVM 22.1.8); .text bytes compared with llvm-objcopy.
Raw trace gunzipped from the archived artifact and checked against the archived proof record.
Each syscall's stack is delimited from its completion line. Bun frames are resolved as vma = bracket + 0x460000 and symbolized with llvm-symbolizer --inlines over the unique vmas.

Anchor: a labelled bun frame SYM+OFF must have a defined standard .dynsym symbol SYM whose value equals the profile .symtab value, with profile_value + OFF == bracket + 0x460000, and SYM must be the nearest preceding defined .dynsym symbol at that vma.

archived_binary_identity_record.interpretation: The recorded SHA and ELF build ID identify the mise executable, NOT Bun. Exact Bun binary SHA/build ID were not captured. Bun version/revision above are runtime observations. This receipt does not present the mise identity as Bun identity.

standard_binary.dynsym_shndx_note: In this file .dynsym gives index 16 for .text symbols, but the section table puts .text at index 14 (index 16 is .fini). This receipt uses st_value only.

profile_binary.note: The profile's executable LOAD is at file offset 0x22c6e00, not 0x2067e00. Only vaddrs are shared, so the 0x460000 delta applies to the standard file only; symbol values are used directly.

what_the_archive_records.interpretation: The recorded SHA and ELF build ID identify the mise executable, NOT Bun. Exact Bun binary SHA/build ID were not captured. Bun version/revision above are runtime observations. This receipt does not present the mise identity as Bun identity.

identity_run_reference.note: A different run (head 400c4a9, different kernel). It verified the official binary at the same mise path via /proc/self/exe. It attributed nothing.
identity_run_reference.verdict: nondiscriminating: no new premature-close-before-registration witness occurred, so nothing was attributed. Historical frames remain unattributed.

stdio_pipe_identification.note: Trace lines showing how fds 219 and 221 were created and used in the spawn that the spec windows belong to (child pid 4059). Quoted from the raw trace.

notes: strace labels are the nearest preceding defined .dynsym symbol plus an offset (26/26 spec labels, 154/154 all labels). The offsets can exceed the symbol size (for example +0x78377 on a 134-byte function), so a label does not name the containing function. Function attribution comes from the DWARF output of llvm-symbolizer.
Frames with object [anon:JSJITCode] are anonymous JIT memory, not file-backed by the bun ELF. They are listed and not symbolized. Pre-exec git-child frames and libc frames are not bun frames.
Some DWARF locations are line 0 (Subspace.cpp:0:21), and llint frames resolve to ld-temp.o:0:0. Those are DWARF artifacts, not attributions.

The successful close of 219 at line 304458 closes the socket created at line 303592 (UNIX-STREAM:[28784->28785]). That socket is the child's stdout pipe: dup2 at line 303829 makes its child end (220) fd 1. The same socket identity appears at creation and at this close.
No frame in any window names child_process, net, a socket, or connect (checked over all symbolized functions and locations).
Trace size: 412,792 lines; 373,636 of them are stack lines. Frame lines naming a bun object: 118,693, all with the single path above.
conclusion: attributed under inference (binary identity of run 39723814228)
conclusion_basis: Same install path: every bun object frame in the whole trace (118,693 stack lines) names /home/runner/.local/share/mise/installs/bun/1.3.14/bin/bun, and no other bun path appears. Pid 3697, which issued spec windows A and B, executed that path with argv ["bun","test"] at trace line 10541 (return 0). The identity run 39740743534 verified the same path via /proc/self/exe (sha256 9fd36f87...).
Same runtime revision: the archived record reports bun 1.3.14 at revision 0d9b296af33f2b851fcbf4df3e9ec89751734ba4. The identity run reports the same revision for the same path.

Layout agreement: the release's executable PT_LOAD (file offset 0x2067e00, vaddr 0x24c7e00, delta 0x460000) places every labelled traced frame on its release symbol plus label offset (26/26 spec instances; 154/154 including additional events). The 13 unlabelled spec frames have no defined .dynsym symbol at or below their vma.

Not established: the historical run never recorded the bun executable's sha256 or build-id. The archived record holds mise's values (8d48bc51..., build-id e10fabbd...) and says the Bun identity was not captured. Byte-identity of the historical binary is inferred, not measured.
conclusion_limits: Layout agreement at the traced points does not prove identical bytes elsewhere. The only byte-level fact used is that the release's standard and profile .text sections are identical (text_identity).
The identity run is a separate execution (head 400c4a9, different kernel). It supports the install path and revision, not the historical run's bytes.
The frames show where the traced syscalls were issued and what called them. They do not show which user code or JavaScript caller drove the spawn beyond the stacks recorded.

disagreements_with_planner.result: none: every named frame in the assignment resolves to the stated function and location (see planner_comparison)

disagreements_with_planner.planner_statement: node:child_process passes extra stdio pipes (index 3 and up) to net.connect({fd}), and the native Subprocess keeps ownership of those same fds.
disagreements_with_planner.observed: The fds closed and then registered in this trace are the parent ends of the stdout (child fd 1, via dup2 at line 303829) and stderr (child fd 2, via dup2 at line 303891) pipes of a Bun.spawn/spawnSync child (spawnMaybeSync -> spawnProcessPosix -> SubprocessPipeReader). No frame names child_process, net, or connect. The planner's stdout/stderr reading matches this trace; the index-3-and-up net.connect mechanism is not on this path.
